name: Tinned razor clams
definition: Razor clams packed in a sealed tin or jar.

definition: Scallops packed in a sealed tin or jar.

definition: Eel or elver packed in a sealed tin or jar.

name: Tinned cod
definition: Cod packed in a sealed tin or jar.

name: Eel
definition: Raw freshwater eel of the genus Anguilla, sold whole or as fillets; CITES status is a C17 row.
notes: Weee: Korean Fresh Water Eel Fillet, Frozen 9 oz; also Fresh Kushi Unagi

name: Sablefish (black cod)
definition: Raw sablefish Anoplopoma fimbria, sold as fillets or steaks.
notes: Fish Society: Wild Black Cod (Sablefish) Fillet Steak, and Miso Marinated Black Cod

name: Tilapia
definition: Raw tilapia (Oreochromis and relatives), sold whole or as fillets.
notes: Weee frozen fish: Whole Tilapia, Skinless Tilapia Fillet, Jumbo Whole Tilapia

name: Pangasius [swai; basa]
definition: Raw pangasius catfish (Pangasius hypophthalmus, P. bocourti), sold as fillets under the names swai or basa.
notes: Weee frozen fish: Swai Fillets, Swai Steak; pangasius and basa not named in titles

name: Snakehead
definition: Raw snakehead fish of the genus Channa, sold whole or as fillets.
notes: Weee frozen fish: Oceankist Snakehead Fish Steak and snakehead fillets and slices

name: Pomfret
definition: Raw pomfret (Pampus and Bramidae), sold whole.
notes: Weee frozen fish: Wild Caught Whole Round Silver Pomfret, Frozen 500 g

name: Croaker
definition: Raw croaker or drum (Sciaenidae), including yellow croaker, sold whole or as fillets.
notes: Weee frozen fish: Whole Yellow Croaker 3pcs/PK, Frozen

name: Scad
definition: Raw scad or horse mackerel (Decapterus, Trachurus), sold whole.
notes: Weee frozen fish: Baby Scad, Round Scad, Shortfin/Layang Scad, Frozen 2 lb

name: Milkfish
definition: Raw milkfish Chanos chanos, sold whole or deboned.
notes: Pacific Bay: Fisher Farms Unseasoned Deboned Milkfish (Bangus) 400 g, frozen raw; Weee shows only smoked tinapa

name: Catfish
definition: Raw catfish of the Ictaluridae and Clariidae, sold whole or as fillets; pangasius is J2.1.1.27.
notes: Weee: Catfish Fillet 1.5 lb frozen; Wild Caught Blue Catfish Cleaned 2pc

name: Flounder
definition: Raw flounder (Paralichthys, Platichthys and relatives), sold whole or as fillets.
notes: Weee: Jeju Wild Caught Frozen Flounder Fillet 400 g

name: Smelt
definition: Raw smelt (Osmerus and relatives), small fish sold whole.
notes: Weee frozen fish: Oceankist Wild Caught Smelt Fish with Roe, Frozen 600 g

name: Grouper
definition: Raw grouper (Epinephelus and relatives), sold whole or as fillets.
notes: Weee frozen fish: TSF Tiger Grouper, Frozen 500-600 g

name: Snapper
definition: Raw snapper (Lutjanus and relatives), sold whole or as fillets.
notes: Weee frozen fish: Whole Snapper 3-4 fish, gilled, gutted, scaled, frozen

name: Dover sole
definition: Raw common sole Solea solea, sold whole or as fillets.
notes: Fish Society: Wild British Dover Sole Fillet; whole Dover sole on home page

name: Lemon sole
definition: Raw lemon sole Microstomus kitt, sold whole or as fillets.
notes: Fish Society: Wild Atlantic Lemon Sole Fillets

name: Red mullet
definition: Raw red mullet (Mullus), sold whole or as fillets.
notes: Fish Society: Wild British Butterflied Red Mullet Fillets - 2 Pack

name: Gurnard
definition: Raw gurnard (Triglidae), sold whole or as fillets.
notes: Fish Society: Wild British Gurnard Fillets, two raw frozen fillets per pack

name: John Dory
definition: Raw John Dory Zeus faber, sold whole or as fillets.
notes: Fish Society: Wild British John Dory Fillet, Zeus faber, raw frozen

name: Zander [pike-perch]
definition: Raw zander Sander lucioperca, sold whole or as fillets.
notes: Fischerei Lechler Zanderfilet, Sander lucioperca, scaled boneless chilled fillet; listing now unavailable

name: Carp
definition: Raw carp (Cyprinus carpio and other carps), sold whole or as fillets.
notes: Fish Society: Whole Mirror Carp - Cleaned, farmed, raw frozen

name: Turbot
definition: Raw turbot Scophthalmus maximus, sold whole or as fillets.
notes: Greendale Farm Shop: Turbot Fillets, 2x180g, fresh or frozen option

name: Patagonian toothfish [Chilean sea bass]
definition: Raw Patagonian toothfish Dissostichus eleginoides, sold as fillets under the name Chilean sea bass.
notes: Kolikof: Chilean Sea Bass Fillets, flash-frozen raw, also called Patagonian Toothfish; sold out

name: Spot prawn
definition: Spot prawn Pandalus platyceros, sold whole, raw or frozen.
notes: Weee prawn page: Large Canadian Spot Prawn, Frozen 2.2 lb

name: Northern prawn [sweet shrimp; amaebi]
definition: Northern or sweet prawn Pandalus borealis, small cold-water prawn sold raw or cooked.
notes: Weee prawn page: Royal Greenland Cooked Greenlandic Sweet Prawns; Pandalus not named

name: Argentine red shrimp
definition: Argentine red shrimp Pleoticus muelleri, sold frozen whole or peeled.
notes: Weee prawn page: Wild Argentine Red Shrimp, peeled or head on, frozen

name: White shrimp
definition: Shrimp sold as white or whiteleg shrimp (Litopenaeus vannamei, L. setiferus).
notes: Weee prawn page: several White Shrimp listings, peeled and head-on, frozen

name: Tiger prawn
definition: Black tiger prawn Penaeus monodon sold under the name tiger; a pack saying only king prawn is J2.1.2.03.
notes: Weee prawn page: Black Tiger Head On Shell On Prawns; Ocean Pearl Tiger Shrimp

name: Giant freshwater prawn
definition: Giant river prawn Macrobrachium rosenbergii, sold whole.
notes: Weee prawn page: Fresh Water Head On Shrimp (Prawn) 2-4pc/lb, Frozen

name: Crayfish [crawfish]
definition: Freshwater crayfish (Procambarus, Astacus and relatives) sold whole or as tail meat.
notes: Weee: Crawfish Medium Tail Meat, Frozen 1 lb; tail meat form shown

name: Fried fish cake [satsuma-age]
definition: Formed cake of seasoned fish paste deep-fried without batter or crumb, not filled or sauced.
notes: Weee: Shirakiku and Marutama Suisan Satsuma Age Fish Cake, frozen
